caption: The drawing depicted on the round plate shows a steam locomotive pulling three passenger cars, each with four wheels, moving from left to right. There are several human figures visible, including what looks like a driver or engineer on the locomotive and some people seated or standing in the train cars. Behind the train, the background features trees, bushes, and a few small buildings, with distant hills or mountains further back. The scene is encircled by a decorative wide border featuring images of seashells and foliage interspersed around the edge. The plate and drawing appear monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray and black, suggestive of an old or antique style. The composition has a circular central scene and a border, with all designs organized symmetrically within the round format of the plate.
title: Plate - "Baltimore and Ohio Railroad"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
